description: Create one of the monitors the telemetry guided setup recommends for a service that sends telemetry, as its Recommendations tab makes it: errors (failing requests), slow_requests (p95 latency), exceptions (unhandled exceptions) or error_logs (a spike in error logs). It opens an alert for the team, never an incident on a status page. Call it once for each monitor. One that reads data the project does not send yet is refused, and so is one the service has already: a second identical call makes none. On OneUptime Cloud's Free plan each new monitor is billed as you use it, at $1 a month, and details say so. Acts as the person signed in (OAuth), with their permissions; an API key cannot.
name: set_up_service_monitor
title: Set Up Service Monitor
